title: Victoria Park Elora stairs replacement put on hold
subtitle: Pierpoint commemorative plaque agreement, advisory committee appointments, and a delegation from the Elora Centre for the Arts.
overview: The Committee of the Whole recommended that staff not proceed with replacing the Victoria Park Elora stairs at this time. Tender results received in August showed the project cost, estimated at $625,000, exceeds the current budget. The committee also recommended that staff pursue other funding sources and report back to Council before the 2025 budget is adopted {{vote:m4}}. Members also asked staff for a report on the communication plan for the community partnership program.

The committee recommended that the Mayor and Clerk sign an agreement with Parks Canada Agency to install a commemorative plaque recognizing Richard Pierpoint at the Pierpoint Fly Fishing Nature Reserve {{vote:m2}}.

It also recommended appointments to two advisory committees: the Healthy Communities Advisory Committee {{vote:m5}} and the Economic Prosperity & Growth Advisory Committee {{vote:m6}}. The committee heard from representatives of the Elora Centre for the Arts, who spoke about maintaining a heritage building and the need for sustainable capital funding. These recommendations go to Council for adoption.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended that staff not proceed with replacing the stairs at this time and pursue alternative funding, reporting back before the 2025 budget is adopted.
The committee recommended authorizing the Mayor and Clerk to sign an agreement with Parks Canada Agency to install a plaque recognizing Richard Pierpoint at the Pierpoint Fly Fishing Nature Reserve.
The committee recommended appointing nine individuals to the Healthy Communities Advisory Committee.

decisions.item: Economic Prosperity & Growth Advisory Committee appointments
decisions.detail: The committee recommended appointing nine members, including representatives of the Elora BIA, Fergus BIA, Wellington Federation of Agriculture and Chamber of Commerce.
